speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: AVA will continue to conduct relevant studies and research to inform its policies and facilitate a science-based approach to animal management.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: AVA has also been carrying out similar studies on birds, as well as conducting trials to test the effectiveness of various bird deterrent methods.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Our animal welfare groups are also pitching in, for example, in conducting sterilisation on Pulau Ubin as well as Jurong Island.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We also need the community to do their part in helping to reduce potential animal-human conflicts in our society.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For example, if everyone practises responsible pet ownership and refrains from feeding strays, the number of stray animals will fall and present a much smaller problem.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: AVA has been and will continue to work with various animal welfare groups on public education for responsible pet ownership.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I am looking forward to the results of that study.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: One, can the Senior Minister of State clarify how much does AVA pay the contractors for each dog, cat or monkey caught?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, the Senior Minister of State mentioned about the professional assessment.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I check who does these assessments as well as how they are actually conducted?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Thirdly, a point which is in the Parliamentary Question, can the Senior Minister of State clarify whether AVA expects an increase in expenditure for culling over the next three years?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The second question is about how AVA does the assessment.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: They will look at the nature of the complaint or feedback and verify the facts.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Surveillance, whether by AVA officers or by the deployment of cameras, is also often used.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Information on the population of animals, their activities, proximity to human habitation and interactions with humans factor into these assessments.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: As for the Member's third question about whether AVA expects expenditure to increase in the coming years, I do not think we are able to project.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It depends on the risks and whether human-animal conflicts rise or fall, and whether public education helps mitigate that, along with the animal welfare groups' efforts in working with us to rehome animals.
